general_rules.rule: The follower type and equipment table expands the ACKS core follower table to include the new classes in this source.
Barbarian follower sets demonstrate that follower tables may be modified to reflect distinct cultures or traditions.
Apprentices include 1st level dwarven machinists, elven enchanters, Nobiran wonderworkers, priestesses, venturers, warlocks, and witches.
Leader types include 1st-3rd level anti-paladins, barbarians, mystics, paladins, shamans, Thrassian gladiators, and Zaharan ruinguards.
Apprentices and leader types can be created using pre-generated class templates or generated and equipped using the Character Creation rules in Chapter 1.
